flagged.title: Peace, Justice & Forgiveness
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly presents Nelson Mandela as a figure who used faith to fight injustice peacefully and reject violence/terrorism, which would lose marks in a GCSE RS exam where Desmond Tutu is the correct Christian exemplar.

mark_affecting.quote: You can look to incredible modern figures like Malala Yousafzai and Nelson Mandela, they fought immense injustices using their faith to inspire peace and education, utterly rejecting terrorism.

flagged.title: Weapons of Mass Destruction & Peacemaking
flagged.reason: Naming the Red Cross as a religious organisation (F8) is mark-affecting because GCSE exam specifications require naming a religious charity/organisation responding to victims of war, and the Red Cross is a secular, neutral body.

mark_affecting.quote: Christian Aid, CAFOD, and the Red Cross, which was actually founded on Christian principles of compassion.
